purpose: Prompt-only self pilot comparing direct Codex CLI against argus-skill.
notes: Use the generated instruction text only as the task prompt.
Do not inspect verifier internals or solutions while running the task.
One developer should not run the exact same task in both conditions; use matched pairs instead.

pairs.rationale: Medium security tasks with short expert estimates.
Medium data-processing tasks with file/transformation objectives.
Medium software-engineering tasks with concrete artifacts.
Medium debugging/recovery tasks that require investigation.
Medium system/setup tasks with observable final state.
Medium build/debug tasks that historically exercise agent iteration.
